name: AddonCraft for Elementor

sections.description:
AddonCraft for Elementor – Supercharge Your Website with Powerful Custom Widgets!

Enhance your Elementor experience with AddonCraft, a must-have plugin that provides a collection of highly customizable widgets to take your website design to the next level. Whether you’re a developer, designer, or business owner, AddonCraft helps you create stunning, dynamic layouts without touching a single line of code.

Light Weight & Instant Loading

Your Website will load instantly and edit in real-time – no technical debt, no speed compromises, just smooth performance.

🔥 Key Features:
✔ Exclusive Custom Widgets – Access unique widgets not available in default Elementor.
✔ Easy Drag & Drop – Seamlessly integrate widgets into your pages with Elementor’s intuitive builder.
✔ Fully Responsive – Ensure your designs look perfect on all devices.
✔ Lightweight & Optimized – Built for speed without compromising functionality.
✔ Regular Updates – Get new widgets and improvements frequently.

Expert Support

We have an extraordinary support team ready to help you. Ask your questions in the support forum, or contact us directly through live chat and contact form.

FREE ELEMENTOR ADDONS AND COUNTING

  1. Marquee
  2. Product Slider
  3. Before After Image Comparison
  4. Logo Infinite Slider
  5. Stylish Layouts with Widgets you can fully customize

🎨 Why Choose AddonCraft?
Save Time & Effort – No need for custom coding or multiple plugins.
Boost Creativity – Stand out with advanced design elements.
User-Friendly – Perfect for beginners and professionals alike.

sections.installation:
Note : This plugin works with Elementor. Make sure you have Elementor installed.

  1. install the plugin through the WordPress plugins screen directly.
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ screen in WordPress.
  3. All available elements are accessible within the Elementor editor interface.
  4. All these elements are organized under the ‘AddonCraft’ category in your Elementor widget panel for easy access.
sections.faq:
Can I use the plugin without Elementor Page Builder?

This is specifically an Elementor add-on, so it requires Elementor to function properly. It cannot be used as a standalone plugin.

Does it work with any theme?

Absolutely! It will work with any theme where Elementor works.

Do i need Elementor Pro?

This add-on works with the free version of Elementor – the premium version isn’t required.
